_comment: P8 verify waivers for lumina-par. Each entry is a HUMAN decision (gate.py load_waivers refuses an entry lacking reason/approved). Waived findings still appear in the gate result under 'waived' - they are recorded, not erased.

waivers.reason: FALSE POSITIVE in check_silk, refuted by the footprint geometry. TP101 uses stock TestPoint:TestPoint_Pad_D1.5mm, whose F.SilkS fp_circle is radius 0.950 mm with (fill no) and a 0.12 mm stroke - so the printed ring spans radius 0.890 to 1.010 mm, while the pad is radius 0.750 mm. They do not intersect; there is a 0.140 mm gap. The reported 1.77 mm2 is exactly the WHOLE pad area (pi x 0.75^2 = 1.767), which is the signature of intersecting the pad with a FILLED disc of radius 0.95 - i.e. check_silk is not honouring (fill no). Corroborated two ways: kicad-cli DRC, which the skill's own guidance says to trust over check_silk, reports ZERO silk violations on this board; and the 2.0x2.0 mm TestPoint variant used on TP501/TP502, whose silk is drawn as four fp_lines outside the pad, is not flagged. P9 dfm_check runs a different implementation on the exported gerbers and will re-check this independently. Fix belongs in check_silk (honour fill no, intersect the annulus), not in this board.
waivers.approved: Ihsan S. (system owner), 2026-08-08, at the P8/H4 checkpoint, on the geometry evidence above; recorded in state.json
